name: General Interface Solution (GIS) Holding Limited
summary: General Interface Solution (GIS) Holding Limited provides touch and display module solutions in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers touch display solutions combining cover glass, touch sensors, and LCD display modules. It also provides BPI Business Platform solutions, including total solutions, co-location, and touch display technology services. The company's products are used in wearable devices, mobile phones, tablet PCs, notebooks, automotive applications, AIO products, PND, portable TVs, and interactive whiteboards.
